title: news service install
description: Register the Bureau service under the user's own account (ADR 0007 decision 12). Karthik runs it in his own terminal: it re-launches elevated, checks that the account resolves to his own SID, asks for his Windows password at a prompt that does not echo, copies news.exe to `%ProgramFiles%\News\news.exe` in a folder only administrators can write, grants 'Log on as a service', creates or updates the service at that path with only SeChangeNotifyPrivilege, and adds Board's log-on entry for the installed binary. `--dry-run` prints the plan and changes nothing. It is Windows administration, not a Hotline action.
